 Scorecard

 Sri Lanka complete second-highest chase in ODI history

 South Africa complete famous victory published at 15:02 BST 15:02 BST 
 Image source, Getty Images It's all over in Gqeberha! 
 Despite so much time lost from rain, South Africa have managed to thrash Australia by an innings and 31 runs. 
 Australia have been bowled out for 295, despite resistance from Travis Head's century and Scott Boland's gritty 40 from 166 balls. 
 Kagiso Rabada finished with 4-77, and Wiaan Mulder took 3-64. 
 It's set up for a thrilling series decider which starts on Tuesday 27 October in Cape Town.

 Fernando moves to 63.
